page.notes: Printed page number reads "28y", transcribed as 287; the final digit is uncertain. The Greek words ἀνοχῆς and ἀξιώσει are doubtful readings, marked [?]. The marginal note is printed in the right margin, placed at the Cicero-ronis line. Several words of the running text are slightly blurred, notably "reportata", "instituta" and "auxilij", but I read them as printed. Abbreviations and the long s have been kept as printed, with s and u/v normalised as required.
